highestSignals.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.
